scope: Original finite graph/arithmetic checks. No fetched model code, trained model, simulator or navigation benchmark.

P1_history_dependence.establishes: One current location is insufficient for this precisely specified history-dependent task.
P1_history_dependence.does_not_establish: Prevalence in R2R/RxR, failures of any learned policy, or novelty of automata/product-graph planning.

P3_first_order_aliasing.establishes: These distributions share every timewise event marginal and therefore every additive discounted event mean, but differ on an ordered joint event.
P3_first_order_aliasing.does_not_establish: Actual NavQ target collision frequency, universal failure of its complete architecture, or learnability of unseen hidden facts.

P4_failure_nonidentifiability.establishes: A failed episode is compatible with both correct and incorrect identity under this contract.
P4_failure_nonidentifiability.does_not_establish: That every benchmark obeys this simplified contract or a measured PSG-Nav memory-poisoning rate.
